units.source_text: 山庄里的人听见匂亲王船上开路唱道之声渐去渐远，知道他不会到山庄里来了，大家大失所望。

en.t: The people at the mountain villa heard the voices clearing the way from Prince Niou's boat grow farther and farther away, and realizing that he would not be coming to the villa, they were all bitterly disappointed.

units.source_text: 准备迎接贵客的侍女们，也都垂头丧气。

en.t: The gentlewomen who had prepared to welcome the honored guest were all downcast as well.

units.source_text: 大女公子尤为伤心，她想：“果如外人所说：此人的心像鸭跖草的颜色一般容易变更。

en.t: The elder young lady was especially hurt, and thought, "It is just as people say: this man's heart changes as easily as the color of a dayflower.

units.source_text: 我仿佛听人说起：男人最善于说假话。

en.t: I seem to have heard people say that men are better than anyone at telling lies.

units.source_text: 这里几个身份低微的侍女，共谈古代故事，说男人对于自己所不爱的女人，会装作很爱的样子，说出许多甜言蜜语来。

en.t: Some of the lower-ranking gentlewomen here, when they talk together about old tales, say that men will pretend to deeply love women they do not love at all and speak all manner of sweet words to them.

units.source_text: 我一向以为：只有品格低劣的人中，才有这种口是心非的男人；身份高贵的男人就全然不同，他们要顾全世誉，言行必然谨慎小心，不会胡说妄为。

en.t: I had always thought that only among people of low character were there men whose words and hearts were so false; noblemen, I thought, were entirely different, for they had to protect their public reputation and would surely be careful in word and deed, never speaking or acting recklessly.

units.source_text: 如今方知这估计是错误的了。

en.t: Only now do I understand that this judgment was wrong.

units.source_text: 父亲在世之时，也风闻此人性情浮薄，无意和他攀亲。

en.t: When Father was still alive, he too had heard rumors that this man was frivolous by nature and had no wish to form a marriage tie with him.

units.source_text: 只因薰中纳言屡次夸说此人异常多情，终于意外地迎接他为妹婿，平添了这许多烦恼，真乃无谓之极！

en.t: Only because Middle Counselor Kaoru repeatedly praised him as unusually affectionate did we unexpectedly accept him as my sister's husband, bringing all this needless trouble upon ourselves. How utterly pointless it was!

units.source_text: 他浅薄无情，看不起我的妹妹，中纳言想必知道，不知作何感想。

en.t: He is shallow and heartless, and looks down on my sister; the Middle Counselor must know this, but I wonder what he thinks of it.

units.source_text: 这里虽然没有特别客气的人，但众侍女心中都在讥诮，这真成了可耻的笑柄！”

en.t: Although there is no one here who is especially formal or ceremonious, all the gentlewomen must be mocking us in their hearts. This has truly become a shameful laughingstock!"

units.source_text: 她左思右想，心绪缭乱，但觉烦恼无穷。

en.t: She turned the matter over and over in her mind until her thoughts were in turmoil, feeling only that her distress had no end.

units.source_text: 二女公子本人则因匂亲王以前偶尔来时，曾对她立下山盟海誓，故存信赖之心。

en.t: The younger young lady herself, however, trusted Prince Niou because on his earlier occasional visits he had sworn solemn vows to her.

units.source_text: 她想：“无论如何，总不会完全变心。

en.t: She thought, "Whatever happens, surely he cannot have changed his heart completely.

units.source_text: 他不能常来，定然是由于不可避免的故障。”

en.t: If he cannot come often, it must be because of some unavoidable obstacle."

units.source_text: 她心中以此自慰。

en.t: She comforted herself with this thought.

units.source_text: 然而久不相逢，难免不怀怨恨。

en.t: Yet after so long without meeting him, she could not help feeling resentful.

units.source_text: 好容易来了，却又过门不入，真乃可恨可惜，因此更加伤心了。

en.t: When he finally came, only to pass by the gate without entering, it was both hateful and heartbreaking, and she was all the more grieved.

units.source_text: 大女公子看了妹妹痛苦难堪的神色，想道：“如果妹妹的处境与别人一样幸福，有与普通富贵之家一样的住宅，匂亲王对她不会如此冷淡吧。”

en.t: Seeing her sister's painfully distressed expression, the elder young lady thought, "If my sister's situation were as fortunate as other people's, and if she had a residence like those of ordinary wealthy noble families, Prince Niou would not treat her so coldly."

units.source_text: 越发觉得这妹妹可怜了。

en.t: She felt even more pity for her sister.

units.source_text: 她想：“我如果长生在世，恐怕也会遭逢同样的命运吧。

en.t: She thought, "If I live on for a long time, I too will probably meet the same fate.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言这般那般地说许多话，无非是要打动我的心。

en.t: Middle Counselor Kaoru says all sorts of things, but they are only meant to move my heart.

units.source_text: 我虽然一心想拒绝他，然而托词也有限度，终不能永远搪塞下去。

en.t: Although I am determined to refuse him, there is a limit to excuses, and in the end I cannot put him off forever.

units.source_text: 况且这里的侍女都不知前车之鉴，只管千方百计地劝诱我和他结婚。

en.t: Besides, the gentlewomen here have learned nothing from what happened before and keep trying every possible way to urge me to marry him.

units.source_text: 我心虽然不愿，结果恐难避免。

en.t: Though my heart is unwilling, in the end it may be hard to avoid.

units.source_text: 正因为如此，所以父亲在世之时，屡次谆谆叮嘱，劝我们独身到底。

en.t: It was precisely because of this that, while Father was alive, he repeatedly and earnestly admonished us, urging us to remain unmarried to the end.

units.source_text: 大约他预知有此种事情，所以作此诫告。

en.t: He probably foresaw that such things would happen, and so gave us that warning.

units.source_text: 我们原是薄命之人，所以落得父母双亡，孤苦无依。

en.t: We were ill-fated from the start, and so we have ended up losing both parents, lonely and with no one to rely on.

units.source_text: 倘再加之以遇人不淑，贻笑大方，致使双亲饮恨于地下，实在太不幸了。

en.t: If on top of that we meet unworthy men, become objects of public ridicule, and make our late parents grieve in the underworld, it would be far too unfortunate.

units.source_text: 但愿至少我一人不受此种苦患，而在罪孽未深之前早早死去。”

en.t: I only wish that at least I alone may be spared such suffering and die early, before my sins grow too deep."

units.source_text: 她悲伤之极，心情实甚痛苦，饮食也全然不进了。

en.t: Her grief was extreme and her heart truly suffered; she could no longer take any food at all.

units.source_text: 她只是反复思量自己死后山庄中的情状，日夜悲叹。

en.t: She only kept imagining again and again what the mountain villa would be like after her death, lamenting day and night.

units.source_text: 她看见了二女公子，心中非常难过，想道：“连我这做姐姐的也抛弃了她而死去，教她孤苦伶仃，何以自慰呢！

en.t: When she saw the younger young lady, her heart ached deeply, and she thought, "If even I, her elder sister, abandon her and die, leaving her all alone, what comfort could she possibly have?

units.source_text: 我过去朝夕看到她那美丽的容姿，心甚欢慰，曾经用心抚育她，希望她长成一个高尚优雅的淑女，私下庆喜她的前程有望。

en.t: In the past, seeing her beautiful form morning and evening greatly comforted my heart; I raised her with care, hoping she would grow into a noble and graceful lady, and I secretly rejoiced that her future seemed promising.

units.source_text: 如今虽然嫁得一个身份高贵的皇子，但其人如此冷淡，使她受人讥笑，今后教她有何脸面立身处世，如何能同别人一样享受幸福的生活呢！”

en.t: Now, although she has married a prince of high rank, he is so cold that he has made her the object of ridicule; from now on, how can she face the world, and how can she enjoy a happy life like other people?"

units.source_text: 她再三思量，觉得我姐妹两人毫不足道，活在这世间全无意趣，只是空过一生而已。

en.t: Thinking it over again and again, she felt that the two sisters were utterly insignificant, that there was no joy at all in living in this world, and that their lives would merely pass in emptiness.

units.source_text: 念之不胜伤心。

en.t: The thought filled her with unbearable sorrow.
